
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:3[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 2 must be LOW during boot for flash programming.

 [dim]2 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]3 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:4[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 5 controls boot debug output. Usually safe for general use.

 [dim]3 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin trig: Output = 5
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^[/yellow]


[red bold]-- DEVICE PIN ERROR -- main.volt:5[/red bold]

`HCSR04` needs 2 pins (echo, trig) but the declaration only provides one. Missing: echo, trig.

 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin trig: Output = 5
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     device dist: HCSR04 on trig at 5
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]           ^^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Use the named-pins syntax: `device dist: HCSR04(echo: <gpio>, trig: <gpio>)`[/cyan]
